basic_info.description: This polished two-bed, two-bath condo in a contemporary 2014 elevator building in Duboce Triangle is chock full of fabulous finishes. The open floor plan features high ceilings, wide plank wood floors, and oversized windows. A chef's kitchen with Bertazonni gas range and additional stainless-steel appliances, an inviting island, Caesarstone countertops and custom cabinetry is open to the living/dining room combination. A glass door in the living room leads to the private patio. The primary bedroom has a huge walk-in closet, and the primary bath features gorgeous modern finishes and a spa-like walk-in shower. The second bedroom also has a sizable closet. The second full bath features modern finishes, shower over tub, and dual vanity sinks. The in-unit washer and dryer are in a large laundry room that offers plenty of storage space. The building's rooftop deck boasts panoramic views. One-car parking is included. This wonderful end-unit condo is on the 15th Street side of the building, rather than busy Market Street. Fabulous Duboce Triangle location steps from the Castro and close to the Lower Haight, Mission Dolores, and the Mission. Nearby public transportation and easy freeway access make this centrally-located condo a breeze for commuters. Professionally managed HOA.
